description: This public Zenodo record provides annual weather-tail indices for 368 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 1973–2024, with a companion daily weather panel, identifier crosswalk and variable dictionary. The article reports 19,136 city-year observations derived from harmonized temperature and precipitation records. Zenodo lists five public files under CC BY 4.0. The indicators can support comparative climate-risk screening for city infrastructure, but they are statistical summaries of historical weather, not flood depth, heat exposure at individual assets or future projections. The article says seasonal Fourier climatology was removed without a time trend or calendar fixed effects; the repository description instead mentions detrending and week fixed effects. That unresolved methods discrepancy, city aggregation and threshold choices limit numerical interpretation until the source code is checked. A reviewer-assessed use is ranking relative city exposure for scenario selection, not directly calibrating an asset fragility curve. data-nex-gddp-cmip6 is related climate input of a different type. No data file or construction code was downloaded.
